meta.title: GeniusClip — free instant replay for Windows
meta.description: A free Windows app that keeps the last minutes of your game in memory and saves them as a clip with Alt+F8. No account, no ads, open source (GPL-3.0).
nav.label: Sections
lang.label: Language
hero.lead: GeniusClip is a free app for Windows. It keeps the last minutes of your game in memory and saves them as a clip when you press Alt+F8. No account, no ads, and the code is open.
dl.mobile: GeniusClip runs on Windows PCs. Open this page there, or copy the link.
features.title: What it does
f1.title: Instant replay
f1.text: The last minutes of your game are always in memory. Alt+F8 saves them as a clip, even if you never pressed record.
f2.title: GPU encoding
f2.text: Your NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics card compresses the video, so your frame rate barely moves.
f3.title: In-game menu
f3.text: Alt+X opens a menu over the game. It's a separate window and nothing is injected into the game, so it's safe with anti-cheat.
f4.title: Gallery and trimming
f4.text: Clips are sorted by game. Cut what you don't need and set game and mic volume separately.
f5.title: Noise suppression
f5.text: Removes keyboard clicks, fan hum and background noise from your mic.
f6.title: Send to Telegram
f6.text: “Send” copies the clip; paste it into a chat with Ctrl+V.
f7.title: Favorites
f7.text: Star a good clip and find it later on the Favorites tab in the gallery.
f8.title: 14 languages
f8.text: English, русский, қазақша and 11 more interface languages.
f9.title: Updates
f9.text: The app checks GitHub for updates and installs them with one click.
f10.title: Light on resources
f10.text: Frames where nothing changed aren't encoded again, which saves work and disk space.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Windows says “Windows protected your PC”. Is that OK?
faq.a1: Yes. The installer doesn't have a digital signature yet, so Windows doesn't recognize it. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
faq.q2: Can anti-cheat ban me for it?
faq.a2: No. GeniusClip doesn't inject into games or touch their files — it captures the screen with standard Windows tools, like OBS or Discord.
faq.a3: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Best with a recent NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics card — then recording barely loads your system.
faq.a4: In “Videos\GeniusClip”, with a folder per game. You can change the folder in settings.
faq.a5: Yes. No ads, no sign-up, no subscription.
faq.a6: You don't have to: the app checks for updates and installs them with one click.
